en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 9. My father and ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Abil Qāsim Hārūn ibn Muslim ibn Sa’dān, from Mas’adah ibn Sadaqah, who said:

I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)), “What is the reward for one who goes to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.)?” Imam (a.s.) said, “Going to Hajj with the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) will be registered for him.” I said, “May I sacrifice myself for you! Going to Hajj with the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.)?!” Imam (a.s.) replied, “Yes and (even) two Hajj (with the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.)).” I said, “May I sacrifice myself for you! Two Hajj?!” Imam (a.s.) replied, “Yes and (even) three Hajj (with the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.)).” Imam (a.s.) kept increasing the number until he reached ten and then I said, “May I sacrifice myself for you! Ten Hajj with the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.)?!” Imam (a.s.) replied, “Yes and (even) twenty Hajj (with the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.)).” I said, “May I sacrifice myself for you! Even twenty Hajj?!” Imam (a.s.) kept increasing the number until he reached fifty and then he stopped.
